name: COUNT_DISTINCT_BASIC
description: count(DISTINCT col) returns number of distinct non-NULL values

name: SUM_DISTINCT_BASIC
description: sum(DISTINCT col) sums each distinct value once

name: AVG_DISTINCT_BASIC
description: avg(DISTINCT col) averages distinct values

name: GROUP_CONCAT_DISTINCT_BASIC
description: group_concat(DISTINCT col) joins distinct values once

name: FILTER_COUNT_STAR_PREDICATE
description: count(*) FILTER (WHERE x>0) counts only matching rows

name: FILTER_SUM_X_IS_NOT_NULL
description: sum(x) FILTER (WHERE y IS NOT NULL) restricts inputs

name: GROUP_CONCAT_ORDER_BY_DESC
description: group_concat(col ORDER BY other DESC) orders aggregated values

name: GROUP_CONCAT_DELIMITER_ORDER_BY
description: group_concat(col, sep ORDER BY other) custom delimiter with sort

name: STRING_AGG_ALIAS_OF_GROUP_CONCAT
description: string_agg is available in SQLite 3.45 as alias of group_concat

name: GROUP_BY_HAVING_AGGREGATE
description: GROUP BY ... HAVING aggregate(...) basic

name: GROUP_BY_MULTIPLE_COLUMNS
description: GROUP BY two columns produces a row per distinct combo

name: GROUP_BY_EXPRESSION_LOWER
description: GROUP BY lower(col) buckets by lowercase value

name: GROUP_BY_ROLLUP_UNSUPPORTED
description: GROUP BY ROLLUP(...) is not supported in SQLite

name: GROUP_BY_GROUPING_SETS_UNSUPPORTED
description: GROUP BY GROUPING SETS(...) is not supported in SQLite

name: AGGREGATE_OVER_EMPTY_SET
description: Aggregates over empty table: count=0; sum/avg/min/max=NULL

name: AGGREGATE_OVER_ALL_NULL_SET
description: Aggregates over all-NULL inputs: count(*) nonzero; rest NULL

name: AGGREGATE_COMPOSITION_SUM_X_TIMES_Y
description: sum(x*y) is row-by-row product summed, not sum(x)*sum(y)

name: AGGREGATE_COLLATE_NOCASE_DISTINCT
description: count(DISTINCT col COLLATE NOCASE) folds case-insensitive duplicates

name: FILTER_PLUS_DISTINCT_COMBO
description: count(DISTINCT x) FILTER (WHERE ...) combines distinct and predicate

name: FILTER_VS_CASE_WHEN_EQUIVALENCE
description: sum(x) FILTER (WHERE p) equals sum(CASE WHEN p THEN x END)
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE t(x INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(6);
SELECT sum(x) FILTER (WHERE x > 3),
       sum(CASE WHEN x > 3 THEN x END),
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x % 2 = 0),
       count(CASE WHEN x % 2 = 0 THEN 1 END)
  FROM t;

name: AGGREGATE_OVER_CTE
description: Aggregate references rows produced by a CTE
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH src(v) AS (VALUES (10),(20),(30),(40),(50))
SELECT count(*), sum(v), avg(v), min(v), max(v) FROM src;

name: AGGREGATE_OVER_CROSS_JOIN
description: Aggregate over a CROSS JOIN sums product of all pairs

name: MULTIPLE_AGGREGATES_SAME_SELECT
description: Several aggregate calls coexist in one SELECT

name: HAVING_AGG_DIFFERENT_FROM_SELECT_AGG
description: HAVING may use aggregates not in SELECT list

name: AVG_EQUALS_SUM_OVER_COUNT_MANUAL
description: avg(x) numerically equals CAST(sum(x) AS REAL)/count(x) (non-NULL count)

name: MIN_MAX_OVER_STRINGS_LEXICOGRAPHIC
description: MIN/MAX on TEXT compares lexicographically using BINARY collation

name: MIN_MAX_OVER_BLOBS_BYTEWISE
description: MIN/MAX over BLOB compares byte-by-byte

name: WHERE_BEFORE_GROUP_BY
description: WHERE filters rows BEFORE grouping, affecting per-group aggregates

name: GROUPBY_EMPTY_VS_NO_GROUPBY_EMPTY
description: GROUP BY on empty input yields zero rows; aggregate without GROUP BY yields one row

name: HAVING_IS_NULL_FILTER
description: HAVING sum(v) IS NULL retains all-NULL groups

name: TOTAL_EMPTY_RETURNS_ZERO_REAL
description: total() returns 0.0 on empty (and on all-NULL); sum() returns NULL

name: TOTAL_ALL_NULL_RETURNS_ZERO_REAL
description: total(x) on all-NULL rows is 0.0, distinct from NULL of sum

name: AGGREGATE_IN_SUBQUERY_IN_SELECT_LIST
description: Per-row scalar subquery referencing aggregate of another query

name: PERCENTILE_CONT_REQUIRES_CAPABILITY
description: percentile_cont not available in default SQLite build — gated by capability
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH v(x) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4),(5))
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) FROM v;

name: MEDIAN_REQUIRES_CAPABILITY
description: median() not available in default SQLite build — gated by capability
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
WITH v(x) AS (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4),(5))
SELECT median(x) FROM v;
